info.name: Simple Bank App API (JWT)
info.description:
Full scenario test of the Simple Bank API with JWT authentication.

BEFORE RUNNING: open the collection's Variables tab and set adminPassword (Current value) to the password you gave `python -m app.create_admin`. The admin always logs in with the username `admin`.

The collection registers a customer with a username, logs in, and sends the token automatically on every request. It proves the username `admin` is reserved, checks that customers get 403 on the admin dashboard and on other customers' data, and cleans everything up at the end.

request.description: Public endpoint. Uses a timestamped username and email so the collection can be run repeatedly.
Only the administrator can have the username 'admin'.
Saves the CustomerToken. Every request after this sends it automatically.
Set adminPassword in the collection Variables tab first.
